summary: Comprehensive testing of /pricing page redesign. Fixed critical VIP Elite card text color bug (h3 was dark instead of white due to global CSS !important rule). All requirements verified: 2x2 grid layout, responsive breakpoints, VIP dark theme, CURRENT PLAN badge, Account Settings section, Personalized Savings section, French translations, and footer language toggle.

fixed_issues.issue: Plan name 'VIP Elite' had dark text color (rgb(26,26,26)) instead of white on dark background
fixed_issues.root_cause: Global CSS rule at line 1805-1806 in index.css: 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { color: #1a1a1a !important; }' was overriding Tailwind's text-white class
fixed_issues.fix: Added CSS override for VIP card: '[data-testid="plan-card-vip"] h3 { color: #ffffff !important; }'

test_results.card_order: PASS - [Starter, Premium] top row, [Partner Pro, VIP Elite] bottom row
test_results.current_plan_badge: PASS - 'Current Plan' badge visible on Starter card for unauthenticated users

critical_code_review_comments: Global CSS rule with !important for h1-h6 colors (line 1805-1806 in index.css) can cause issues with dark-themed components. Consider using more specific selectors or CSS custom properties instead of !important.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing page redesign complete and tested. VIP Elite card text color bug was fixed by adding CSS override in index.css. All responsive breakpoints (390px, 768px, 1280px) tested with no horizontal overflow. French translations working correctly. Account Settings section visible when logged in. The admin user (charbeladmin@bidvex.com) has Partner Pro subscription.
